nameEn: Activities of households as employers of domestic personnel
description: This class includes the activities of households as employers of domestic personnel such as maids, cooks, waiters, valets, butlers, laundresses, gardeners, gate keepers, stable keepers, chauffeurs, caretakers, governesses, babysitters, tutors, secretaries, etc.
includes: activities of households employing domestic staff
employment of cooks and domestic workers
excludes: activities of employment agencies placing domestic workers, see 7810
